O IPMA prevê chuva e vento muito fortes: IPMA, the Portuguese weather service, forecasts very heavy rain and very strong winds for Wednesday, 11 November. As soon as possible, put away or firmly secure anything that could be blown away by the wind. Avoid staying under trees and going to the beach or the cliffs. Keep the doors and windows of accommodation and caravans closed, and make sure electrical equipment and extension cables are well protected from the rain. If you have any concerns, please talk to us.
